content.short: Overtime Markets provides a premium Web3 sportsbook.
content.description: Overtime Markets enables users to purchase positions tied to their favorite sports teams and athletes as a season unfolds, letting them back their favorites through the highs and lows. Supported sports include soccer, football, basketball, UFC, tennis, and eSports, among others, so you can follow and back a team or athlete throughout the year. All positions and activity are recorded on the blockchain, providing a transparent way to track performance from kickoff to the season’s end, with a verifiable record of participation for fans.
